V11.1 - The Invasion: a new INVASION menu entry opens five missions of the Darkseid War: Metropolis, Gotham, Atlantis, Themyscira and the Falling Sky. Five new enemy types (Parademon, Heavy Parademon, Apokoliptian Elite, Assault Parademon, War-Machine Operator), three war machines (Walker, Tank, Assault Craft) with weak points, and four kinds of Boom Tube (Standard, Heavy, Elite, Unstable). Stand beside a tube and hold G to close it with your hero's own method, or just destroy it. Red zones are telegraphed attacks. Everything is stored locally. V10.4 - The Anti-Monitor: a new CRISIS CAMPAIGN menu entry opens six chapters of Crisis on Infinite Earths: hold off shadow demons over Metropolis, rescue the survivors of Earth-2, beat an antimatter-corrupted Ultraman, cut the antimatter links at the edge of reality, break the corrupted Owlman and Superwoman, then face the four-phase Anti-Monitor. His reality shifts change the arena, and in the last phase five squads take the field in turn so that all fourteen heroes fight, ending in a combined multiverse strike. Progress saves, and exports with the rest of your progression.

V10.3 - The Crime Syndicate: a new CRIME SYNDICATE menu entry opens six chapters on Earth-3: Johnny Quick, Power Ring, Superwoman, Owlman and Ultraman each get a boss fight with three phases, telegraphed attacks and recovery windows, then the finale pits your team against Ultraman, Owlman and Superwoman at once. Superman, Batman, Wonder Woman, Flash and Green Lantern hit their own counterpart harder. Defeating bosses unlocks cosmetic costumes and trophies. All 14 heroes and 364 teams are supported.

V10.2 - Infinite Earths: a new MULTIVERSE menu entry opens five alternate Earths - Flashpoint Gotham, Red Son Metropolis, Earth-3, the Collapsing Multiverse and the Anti-Matter Universe. Reality fractures swap the battlefield mid-mission (walls, hazards, enemies and art), glowing portals link the map, and each Earth has its own hazards and objectives. Clear an Earth to unlock alternate-reality hero costumes (cosmetic only) in the Alternate Wardrobe. All 14 heroes and all 364 teams are supported.
V10.1.1 - Heroes Beyond Worlds: seven new heroes join the League: Supergirl, Nightwing, Green Arrow, Shazam, Cyborg, Zatanna and Constantine. Each has a unique attack, four abilities (Z C V B), an ultimate (X), a space-bar move, an aiming reticle and four costumes. Pick any three of the fourteen heroes in Team Campaign (press C for costumes, M for V10 mastery); every trio has a team ultimate and every pair a team-up.

V9.3 - Living Battlefields: every world now reacts to your powers. In the west plaza of each world look for vault doors (barricades, weakened walls, debris, security terminals, sockets, hidden and phase passages), hazard controls (freeze, contain, stabilize or redirect a hazard for a while), the island cache (Green Lantern bridge) and team combo stations (two different heroes, switch with F1-F3 within 20 seconds: Shadow Circuit, Phantom Infiltration, Amazonian Shield, Frozen Tide, Emerald Bridge). Hold G at a glowing node; the prompt tells you which heroes can use it. Explosions smash crates and weak walls and chain to barrels; electricity charges water; ice locks it. Dynamic events (falling debris, collapses, floods, surges, temporal distortions, energy storms, reinforcements) always show a warning first. Nothing is required: every team can finish every mission. Mastery XP is awarded for wins, and PROGRESS (key P on the world list) shows per-world records.

V9.2 - Heroic Missions: in WORLD OPERATIONS pick a world, then choose Free Patrol or one of its two heroic missions: Civilian Rescue, Bomb Defusal, Vehicle Interception, Defense, Escort, Infiltration, Sabotage or Disaster Response. Read the briefing, pick your three heroes and follow the objective panel. Hold G (or the Interact button) to rescue civilians, defuse bombs, repair, seal rifts and deploy roadblocks; each hero has strengths (Superman stops vehicles bodily, Flash rescues and intercepts fast, Green Lantern deploys roadblocks fast, Batman and Martian Manhunter detect bombs and stay hidden) but every team can finish every mission. Heroic Performance counts civilians saved, optional objectives, collateral damage, damage taken, time, Team-Ups, Team Ultimates and revives for your rank. Records are stored separately from campaigns.

V9.1 - Seven Worlds: choose WORLD OPERATIONS in the main menu to patrol Gotham, Metropolis, Central City, Atlantis, Themyscira, Oa or Mars. Pick a world, pick your three heroes, then work through the objective panel: clear the garrison, hold G at the world mechanism to open the sealed gate, and reach the extraction marker. Every world has its own hazards: searchlights and alarms, traffic, speed lanes and slow-time zones, currents and pressure vents, spear traps and shield barriers, construct bridges and void chasms, crumbling floors, dust storms and illusory walls. Ranks and best times are saved separately from the campaigns.

V8.3 - Justice League Missions: choose TEAM MISSIONS in the main menu for five team missions (Gotham Under Siege, Metropolis Blackout, Speed Force Fracture, Atlantis Rising, The Watchtower). Pick a mission, pick your three heroes, then follow the objective panel at the top. Hold G (or the Interact button on touch screens) next to devices, civilians, relays, rifts and consoles to use them. Hazards (electric fields, shell blasts, currents, slow-time zones, rising water, energy barriers, reactor pulses) hurt all three heroes. Finish for a rank, a results screen and mastery XP for the heroes who are still standing.

V8.2 - United We Stand: in Team Campaign, hits and teamwork fill the Team Synergy meter. Press T (or the Team-Up button) to unleash a Team-Up attack with the nearest living teammate (costs 35 synergy, 7 s cooldown): 21 unique pair attacks. At 100 synergy with all three heroes standing, press Y (or Team Ult) for a three-hero Team Ultimate (25 s cooldown); every one of the 35 trios has one. Rebind both keys on the team-selection screen with K and L.

V8.1 - Assemble the League: the main menu has a new TEAM CAMPAIGN. Pick three heroes (and who starts), then switch between them at any time with F1 / F2 / F3, by clicking the team panels at the top right, or with the buttons under the game on touch screens. The two benched heroes stay in the arena and fight on their own, each with their own hearts, ultimate charge and cooldowns. If a hero falls, control passes to a teammate; stand next to the fallen hero and hold G (or the Revive button) to bring them back (2 revives per level). Team Campaign plays the starter hero’s three levels and boss and does not change solo progression. Team-ups and team ultimates arrive in V8.2.

V7.3.1 - Pause system & fullscreen controls: a ⏸ PAUSE button (top right, above the playfield) and the P key pause every mode and freeze everything, including mission, Boss Rush, Survival and Challenge timers; Esc also opens the pause menu (Resume, Restart, Settings, Main Menu, each with confirmations where needed). While fullscreen, a ⛶ EXIT FULLSCREEN button is always shown top right, and every menu screen has a ◀ BACK button, so Esc is no longer needed to leave fullscreen or a submenu. Browsers may still exit fullscreen themselves when Esc is pressed; the game stays exactly where it was.

V7.3 - Achievements & polish: the main menu now has Achievements (36, earned through real play, with progress bars and small popups), two new Statistics pages (Game Modes, Overview), animated mastery rewards and level-ups, and a reworked Settings screen (export / import with a before-and-after comparison, one-step backup and restore, popup, aura and reduced-motion options). Everything is saved in this browser only.

V7.2 - New Game Modes: the main menu now opens Boss Rush (all seven final bosses in a row with one hero; hearts and ultimate carry over), Survival (endless waves, power-ups, personal bests) and Challenges (ten special missions with medals). In Survival and Challenges, Esc pauses and Backspace (or the END RUN button) ends the run. Records and medals are saved in this browser only.

V7.1 - Progression & Customization: every mission now ends with a rank (D, C, B, A, S, S+), a results screen and mastery XP. Each hero has 4 costumes (3 unlockable), a mastery level up to 20, and progress is saved in this browser only. On the select screen use ◀ ▶ to change costume. Main menu: Hero Mastery, Costumes, Statistics, Settings (export / import / reset save). Esc returns to the menu.

V6.3 - Cinematic Boss Polish: every final boss now has a skippable cinematic introduction (any key or click skips), its own procedural battle music that intensifies each phase, phase-transition animations, a cinematic defeat sequence, and a unique arena with interactive objects (stand on the glowing nodes to strike the boss) and telegraphed environmental hazards that change between phases.

V6.2 - Enemy Expansion: every hero now meets a mini-boss at the end of Level 2 (Arkillo, Captain Cold, Bane, Metallo, Despero, Cheetah, Ocean Master). New foes: Sniper (visible laser), Commander (alerts, calls backup), Heavy Enforcer (telegraphed slams), Speedster (lightning dashes, mostly in Flash's campaign), hero-specific Specialists and Elites. Enemies now flank, take cover, retreat and react when allies fall.

V6.1 - The Seven Villains: clear a hero's third level and its final boss arrives: Sinestro, Reverse-Flash, the Joker, General Zod, Ma'alefa'ak, Ares or Black Manta. Each fights in three phases (100% / 65% / 30%), telegraphs every attack, and opens a vulnerability window when you counter or when it recovers. Watch the boss bar at the top. Reticles: every hero has a unique animated reticle; use the 🎯 Reticle settings button to turn it on or off, change size, opacity, animations or switch to a standard crosshair (saved in this browser). V5.2/V5.3: abilities on Z / C / V / B, ultimate on X, Tab lists everything, Esc/P pauses. Every V4 control still works.

One hit kills you and every lantern. Dying costs a heart and instantly drops you back at the floor entrance. WASD/arrows run, mouse aims, click or Space uses the chosen construct, Shift dashes, E triggers a full anime cutscene finisher on a fallen lantern to siphon ring energy (Enter or a tap skips the cutscene), F throws your items at the boss, M mutes. Every construct drains your ring, and hard-light weapons (hammer, chainsaw, shotgun) shatter after a few kills. Pick a Spectrum Shard at the start of each floor. Each floor has 2 hearts that only restore a heart when you’re missing one. Playing as The Flash: sprint to charge the Speed Force, click for a Flurry strike, Shift to phase through walls, Space for bullet-time. V4 finishers: E = cinematic finisher (6 s, skippable, +300), R = quick finisher (0.5 s, +120, returns you to combat instantly). V4 enemies: Gunners keep their distance and cannot shoot through walls, Bruisers telegraph heavy swings (dodge, dash or parry), Shield Guards block frontal hits (flank them or guard-break with heavy attacks). Enemies only react to what they can see or hear, and search where they last saw you. Other heroes: Batman (Space: smoke pellet, pick up dropped weapons), Superman (right-click: heat vision), Martian Manhunter (Space: psychic overload), Wonder Woman (right-click: parry, Space: lariat), Aquaman (right-click: water jet).
